incoming.name: Charles V, Holy Roman Emperor
incoming.excerpt: The first war with Charles's great nemesis Francis I of France began in 1521.

outgoing.name: Barcelona
outgoing.excerpt: Concerned by Bourbon's scheming, they agreed and Francis arrived in Barcelona on June 12.

outgoing.name: Flanders
outgoing.excerpt: While imprisoned in Spain, Francis signed the Treaty of Madrid, surrendering his claims to Italy, Flanders, and Burgundy.

outgoing.name: Lyon
outgoing.excerpt: When Francis, who was aware of the plot, summoned him to Lyon in October, he feigned illness and fled to Besançon, in Imperial territory.

outgoing.name: Martin Luther
outgoing.excerpt: Charles was meanwhile preoccupied with the issue of Martin Luther, whom he confronted at the Diet of Worms in March 1521.

outgoing.name: Milan
outgoing.excerpt: Francis himself led a second attack on Milan in 1525.
